title_en: Labor Contract Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted for the purposes of perfecting the labor contract system, clarifying the rights and obligations of the parties to labor contracts, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of workers, and building and developing harmonious and stable labor relations.

Article 2 This Law shall apply to the establishment of labor relations, and the conclusion, performance, modification, rescission or termination of labor contracts between organizations such as enterprises, individually-owned economic organizations, and private non-enterprise units within the territory of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as employing units) and workers.
State organs, public institutions, social organizations and workers with whom they establish labor relations shall, when concluding, performing, modifying, rescinding or terminating labor contracts, follow this Law.

Article 3 The conclusion of a labor contract shall follow the principles of lawfulness, fairness, equality, voluntariness, consensus through consultation, and good faith.
A labor contract concluded according to law shall be binding. The employing unit and the worker shall perform the obligations agreed upon in the labor contract.

Article 4 An employing unit shall establish and perfect labor rules and regulations according to law so as to ensure that workers enjoy their labor rights and perform their labor obligations.
When an employing unit formulates, modifies or decides on any rule or regulation or major matter that directly involves the vital interests of workers, such as labor remuneration, working hours, rest and vacation, occupational safety and health, insurance and welfare, employee training, labor discipline, and quota management, it shall have the matter discussed by the workers' congress or all workers, solicit opinions and proposals, and determine it through equal consultation with the trade union or representatives of the workers.
During the implementation of rules and regulations or major decisions, if the trade union or workers deem them inappropriate, they shall have the right to propose to the employing unit that they be modified or improved through consultation.
An employing unit shall publish or inform workers of any rule or regulation or major decision that directly involves the vital interests of workers.

Article 5 The labor administration departments of the people's governments at or above the county level shall, together with the trade union and the representatives of the employing units, establish and perfect a tripartite mechanism for coordinating labor relations so as to jointly study and resolve major issues concerning labor relations.

Article 6 The trade union shall assist and guide workers in concluding and performing labor contracts with the employing unit according to law, and shall establish a mechanism for collective consultation with the employing unit so as to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of workers.
Article 7 An employing unit shall establish labor relations with a worker from the date the employing unit commences using the worker. The employing unit shall keep a roster of workers for reference.

Article 8 When recruiting a worker, the employing unit shall truthfully inform the worker of the job content, working conditions, place of work, occupational hazards, work safety conditions, labor remuneration, and other matters that the worker requests to know; and the employing unit shall have the right to know the basic information of the worker that is directly related to the labor contract, and the worker shall truthfully provide such information.

Article 9 When recruiting a worker, the employing unit shall not detain the worker's resident identity card or other documents, nor shall it request the worker to provide a guarantee or collect property from the worker under any other name.

Article 10 To establish labor relations, a written labor contract shall be concluded.
Where labor relations have been established but a written labor contract has not been concluded at the same time, a written labor contract shall be concluded within one month from the date the employment commences.
Where the employing unit and the worker conclude a labor contract before the employment commences, the labor relations shall be established from the date the employment commences.

Article 11 If no written labor contract is concluded at the same time as the employment commences and the labor remuneration agreed upon with the worker is not clear, the labor remuneration for the newly recruited worker shall be determined according to the standards specified in the collective contract; where there is no collective contract or the collective contract does not specify the matter, equal pay for equal work shall apply.
Article 12 Labor contracts are classified into fixed-term labor contracts, open-ended labor contracts, and labor contracts with a term based on the completion of a specific work task.

Article 13 A fixed-term labor contract refers to a labor contract in which the employing unit and the worker agree on the termination time of the contract.
The employing unit and the worker may conclude a fixed-term labor contract through consultation.

Article 15 A labor contract with a term based on the completion of a specific work task refers to a labor contract in which the employing unit and the worker agree that the term of the contract is conditioned on the completion of a certain task.
The employing unit and the worker may conclude a labor contract with a term based on the completion of a specific work task through consultation.

Article 16 A labor contract shall take effect upon consensus between the employing unit and the worker reached through consultation, and after the employing unit and the worker sign or affix their seals on the text of the labor contract.
The employing unit and the worker shall each hold one copy of the labor contract text.

Article 18 Where the standards for labor remuneration and working conditions agreed upon in a labor contract are unclear, giving rise to a dispute, the employing unit and the worker may renegotiate. If the negotiation fails, the provisions of the collective contract shall apply. Where there is no collective contract or the collective contract does not specify labor remuneration, equal pay for equal work shall apply. Where there is no collective contract or the collective contract does not specify standards such as working conditions, the relevant state provisions shall apply.

Article 19 Where the term of a labor contract is not less than three months but less than one year, the probation period shall not exceed one month; where the term is not less than one year but less than three years, the probation period shall not exceed two months; and for a fixed-term or open-ended labor contract with a term of not less than three years, the probation period shall not exceed six months.
Only one probation period may be agreed upon for the same employing unit and the same worker.
No probation period may be agreed upon for a labor contract with a term based on the completion of a specific work task or for a labor contract with a term of less than three months.
The probation period shall be included in the term of the labor contract. If a labor contract only stipulates a probation period, no probation period shall be established and such period shall be deemed the term of the labor contract.

Article 20 The wages of a worker during the probation period shall not be less than the lowest wage for the same position in the unit or 80% of the wage agreed upon in the labor contract, and shall not be less than the minimum wage standard in the locality where the employing unit is located.

Article 21 During the probation period, the employing unit shall not rescind the labor contract unless the worker falls under the circumstances as specified in Article 39 or Paragraph 1 or 2 of Article 40 of this Law. If the employing unit rescinds the labor contract during the probation period, it shall explain the reasons to the worker.

Article 22 Where an employing unit provides specialized training expenses for a worker and conducts professional technical training for such worker, it may enter into an agreement with the worker stipulating a service term.
If the worker violates the agreement on the service term, he or she shall pay liquidated damages to the employing unit in accordance with the agreement. The amount of liquidated damages shall not exceed the training expenses provided by the employing unit. The liquidated damages which the employing unit requires the worker to pay shall not exceed the portion of the training expenses allocable to the unfulfilled part of the service term.
An agreement between the employing unit and the worker on a service term shall not affect the increase of the worker's labor remuneration during the service term in accordance with the normal wage adjustment mechanism.

Article 23 The employing unit and the worker may agree in the labor contract on matters concerning the keeping of the employing unit's trade secrets and intellectual property-related confidential information.
For a worker who has a confidentiality obligation, the employing unit may agree with the worker on a non-competition clause in the labor contract or confidentiality agreement, and agree to give the worker monthly economic compensation during the non-competition period after the rescission or termination of the labor contract. If the worker violates the non-competition agreement, he or she shall pay liquidated damages to the employing unit in accordance with the agreement.

Article 24 The persons subject to non-competition restrictions shall be limited to the employing unit's senior officers, senior technical personnel and other persons who have a confidentiality obligation. The scope, geographical area and term of non-competition restrictions shall be agreed upon by the employing unit and the worker, and such agreements shall not violate the provisions of laws and regulations.
After the rescission or termination of the labor contract, the non-competition restriction period for the persons specified in the preceding paragraph to work for a competing employing unit that produces or operates the same type of products or engages in the same type of business as the current unit, or to start their own business to produce or operate the same type of products or engage in the same type of business, shall not exceed two years.
Article 25 Except for the circumstances as specified in Articles 22 and 23 of this Law, the employing unit shall not agree with the worker that the worker shall bear liquidated damages.
Article 27 If partial voidness of a labor contract does not affect the validity of the remaining parts, the remaining parts shall remain valid.

Article 28 If a labor contract is confirmed as void and the worker has performed labor, the employing unit shall pay the worker labor remuneration. The amount of labor remuneration shall be determined by reference to the labor remuneration of workers of the same or similar positions in the unit.
Article 29 The employing unit and the worker shall fully perform their respective obligations in accordance with the terms of the labor contract.

Article 30 The employing unit shall, in accordance with the provisions of the labor contract and state regulations, pay labor remuneration to the worker in full and on time.
If the employing unit delays or fails to pay labor remuneration in full, the worker may apply to the local People's Court for an order for payment according to law, and the People's Court shall issue such order according to law.

Article 31 The employing unit shall strictly implement the labor quota standards and shall not compel or implicitly compel workers to work overtime. If the employing unit arranges overtime work, it shall pay overtime pay to the workers in accordance with the relevant state regulations.

Article 32 If a worker refuses to comply with an employing unit manager's order in violation of rules or an order to risk operations endangering safety, such refusal shall not be deemed a violation of the labor contract.
A worker shall have the right to criticize, report to and accuse an employing unit of working conditions that endanger life safety and health.
Article 33 A change in the name, legal representative, principal person in charge, or investor of the employing unit shall not affect the performance of the labor contract.

Article 34 In the event of a merger or division of the employing unit, the original labor contracts shall remain effective, and the employing unit that succeeds to the rights and obligations of the original employing unit shall continue to perform the labor contracts.

Article 35 The employing unit and the worker may, through consultation, modify the contents agreed upon in the labor contract. Any modification of the labor contract shall be made in writing.
The employing unit and the worker shall each hold one copy of the text of the modified labor contract.
Article 36 The employing unit and the worker may rescind the labor contract through consultation.

Article 37 A worker may rescind the labor contract by notifying the employing unit in writing thirty days in advance. During the probation period, a worker may rescind the labor contract by notifying the employing unit three days in advance.

Article 43 When an employing unit unilaterally rescinds a labor contract, it shall notify the trade union of the reasons in advance. If the employing unit violates the provisions of laws, administrative regulations or the terms of the labor contract, the trade union shall have the right to demand that the employing unit correct the matter. The employing unit shall study the trade union's opinions and notify the trade union in writing of the result of its handling.

Article 45 Where the term of a labor contract expires but the worker falls under any of the circumstances specified in Article 42 of this Law, the term of the labor contract shall be extended until the corresponding circumstances disappear. However, the termination of the labor contract of a worker who has lost or partially lost the capacity to work as specified in Item (2) of Article 42 of this Law shall be handled in accordance with the relevant state regulations on work-related injury insurance.

Article 47 Economic compensation shall be paid to the worker based on the number of years the worker has worked for the employing unit, at the standard of one month's wage for each full year. For periods of not less than six months but less than one year, it shall be counted as one year. For periods of less than six months, economic compensation equivalent to half a month's wage shall be paid to the worker.
If the monthly wage of the worker is more than three times the average monthly wage of employees in the locality in the previous year as published by the people's government of the municipality directly under the Central Government or the city divided into districts where the employing unit is located, the standard for economic compensation to be paid to the worker shall be three times the average monthly wage of employees, and the maximum number of years for which economic compensation is paid to the worker shall not exceed twelve years.
The monthly wage as mentioned in this Article refers to the average wage of the worker in the twelve months prior to the rescission or termination of the labor contract.

Article 48 If the employing unit rescinds or terminates a labor contract in violation of the provisions of this Law, and the worker demands continued performance of the labor contract, the employing unit shall continue to perform the contract. If the worker does not demand continued performance of the labor contract or the labor contract cannot be continued, the employing unit shall pay compensation in accordance with Article 87 of this Law.
Article 49 The State shall take measures to establish and perfect a system for the cross-regional transfer and continuation of workers' social insurance relations.

Article 50 Upon rescission or termination of a labor contract, the employing unit shall issue a certificate of rescission or termination of the labor contract and shall, within fifteen days, handle the transfer of the worker's personnel file and social insurance relations.
The worker shall, in accordance with the agreement of the parties, handle the handover of work. If the employing unit is required to pay economic compensation to the worker in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Law, such compensation shall be paid upon completion of the handover of work.
The employing unit shall retain the texts of rescinded or terminated labor contracts for at least two years for reference.

Article 73 The labor administrative department of the State Council shall be responsible for the supervision and administration of the implementation of the labor contract system nationwide.
The labor administrative departments of local people's governments at or above the county level shall be responsible for the supervision and administration of the implementation of the labor contract system within their respective administrative regions.
The labor administrative departments of local people's governments at or above the county level shall, in the work of supervision and administration of the implementation of the labor contract system, hear the opinions of trade unions, representatives of enterprises, and relevant competent industry departments.

Article 75 When conducting supervision and inspection, the labor administrative departments of local people's governments at or above the county level shall have the right to review materials related to labor contracts and collective contracts, and the right to conduct on-site inspections of workplaces; employers and workers shall truthfully provide relevant information and materials.
Staff members of the labor administrative department, when conducting supervision and inspection, shall produce their credentials, exercise their powers according to law, and enforce the law in a civilized manner.

Article 76 The competent departments of construction, health, work safety supervision and administration, and other relevant departments of people's governments at or above the county level shall, within their respective functions and duties, supervise and administer the implementation of the labor contract system by employers.

Article 77 Where the lawful rights and interests of a worker are infringed upon, the worker shall have the right to request the relevant department to handle the matter according to law, or to apply for arbitration or institute legal proceedings according to law.

Article 78 Trade unions shall, according to law, safeguard the lawful rights and interests of workers, and supervise the performance of labor contracts and collective contracts by employers. Where an employer violates labor laws and regulations, labor contracts, or collective contracts, the trade union shall have the right to offer opinions or request correction; where a worker applies for arbitration or institutes legal proceedings, the trade union shall provide support and assistance according to law.

Article 79 Any organization or individual shall have the right to report any violation of this Law, and the labor administrative department of the people's government at or above the county level shall promptly verify and handle the matter, and shall reward the persons who have rendered meritorious service in reporting.

Article 80 Where internal rules and regulations of an employer that directly involve the immediate interests of workers violate laws or regulations, the labor administrative department shall order correction and give a warning; if damage is caused to workers, the employer shall bear compensation liability.

Article 81 Where the text of a labor contract provided by an employer does not contain the mandatory clauses of a labor contract as provided for in this Law, or where the employer fails to deliver the text of the labor contract to the worker, the labor administrative department shall order correction; if damage is caused to the worker, the employer shall bear compensation liability.

Article 82 Where an employer fails to conclude a written labor contract with a worker for more than one month but less than one year from the date of employment, the employer shall pay the worker twice the monthly wages.
Where an employer, in violation of the provisions of this Law, fails to conclude an open-ended labor contract with a worker, the employer shall pay the worker twice the monthly wages from the date on which an open-ended labor contract should have been concluded.

Article 83 Where an employer in violation of the provisions of this Law agrees upon a probation period with a worker, the labor administrative department shall order correction; if the illegally agreed probation period has been performed, the employer shall pay compensation to the worker based on the worker's monthly wages after the probation period, calculated for the period of the probation period actually performed that exceeds the statutory probation period.

Article 84 Where an employer, in violation of the provisions of this Law, detains a worker's resident identity card or other certificates, the labor administrative department shall order the employer to return them to the worker within a time limit, and shall impose a penalty in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws.
Where an employer, in violation of the provisions of this Law, collects property from a worker under the name of a bond or other means, the labor administrative department shall order the employer to return the property to the worker within a time limit, and shall impose a fine of not less than RMB 500 yuan but not more than RMB 2,000 yuan per person; if damage is caused to the worker, the employer shall bear compensation liability.
Where a worker lawfully rescinds or terminates a labor contract, and the employer detains the worker's file or other articles, a penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 86 Where a labor contract is confirmed null and void in accordance with the provisions of Article 26 of this Law, and damage is caused to the other party, the party at fault shall bear compensation liability.

Article 87 Where an employer rescinds or terminates a labor contract in violation of the provisions of this Law, the employer shall pay compensation to the worker at twice the standard of economic compensation as provided for in Article 47 of this Law.

Article 89 Where an employer, in violation of the provisions of this Law, fails to issue a written certificate of rescission or termination of the labor contract to the worker, the labor administrative department shall order correction; if damage is caused to the worker, the employer shall bear compensation liability.

Article 90 Where a worker rescinds a labor contract in violation of the provisions of this Law, or violates the confidentiality obligations or non-competition restrictions agreed upon in the labor contract, thereby causing losses to the employer, the worker shall bear compensation liability.

Article 91 Where an employer recruits a worker whose labor contract with another employer has not yet been rescinded or terminated, and this causes losses to the other employer, the employer shall bear joint and several compensation liability.

Article 92 Where a person operates a labor dispatch business without a license in violation of the provisions of this Law, the labor administrative department shall order cessation of the illegal act, confiscate illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains, a fine of not more than RMB 50,000 yuan may be imposed.
Where a labor dispatch unit or employing entity violates the provisions of this Law on labor dispatch, the labor administrative department shall order correction within a time limit; if correction is not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than RMB 5,000 yuan but not more than RMB 10,000 yuan per person shall be imposed, and for the labor dispatch unit, its labor dispatch business license shall be revoked. Where the employing entity causes damage to the dispatched workers, the labor dispatch unit and the employing entity shall bear joint and several compensation liability.

Article 93 For the illegal or criminal acts of an employer that does not have lawful business qualifications, legal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the worker has already performed labor, the unit or its investor shall pay the worker labor remuneration, economic compensation, and compensation according to the relevant provisions of this Law; if damage is caused to the worker, the employer shall bear compensation liability.

Article 94 Where an individual contractor employs workers in violation of the provisions of this Law and causes damage to the workers, the contracting organization and the individual contractor shall bear joint and several compensation liability.

Article 95 Where the labor administrative department, other relevant competent departments, and their staff members neglect their duties, fail to perform their statutory duties, or illegally exercise their powers, thereby causing damage to workers or employers, they shall bear compensation liability; the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given administrative sanctions according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 96 Where public institutions conclude, perform, modify, rescind, or terminate labor contracts with staff members under the employment system, if laws, administrative regulations, or the State Council provide otherwise, those provisions shall prevail; if no provisions are made, the relevant provisions of this Law shall apply.

Article 97 Labor contracts that were lawfully concluded prior to the coming into force of this Law and that remain in effect as of the date of its coming into force shall continue to be performed; the number of consecutive fixed-term labor contracts concluded as referred to in Article 14, paragraph 2, subparagraph 3 of this Law shall be counted from the time a fixed-term labor contract is renewed after the coming into force of this Law.
Where an employment relationship was established prior to the coming into force of this Law but no written labor contract has been concluded, a written labor contract shall be concluded within one month from the date of the coming into force of this Law.
Where a labor contract existing on the date of the coming into force of this Law is rescinded or terminated after the coming into force of this Law, and economic compensation is payable in accordance with Article 46 of this Law, the period for calculating economic compensation shall be counted from the date of the coming into force of this Law; if, prior to the coming into force of this Law, the employer was required to pay economic compensation to the worker in accordance with the then-current relevant provisions, the then-current relevant provisions shall apply.
Article 98 This Law shall come into force on January 1, 2008.
